whenToUse: Scannable codes for two-factor enrolment, invite links, tickets and payment slips.
Server-rendered QR output with no extra dependency.
avoidWhen: Secrets the user must type — show the text key alongside or use backup-codes.
Links on desktop where clicking works better — use a plain link.
a11y: The SVG is role="img" with an aria-label; always show the encoded value or link as text too.
